en: for as the slave of Rome
Let us close ranks in a cohort,
because we are not a people,
Let us unite, let us love one another;
Let us swear to make free
notes: line 1.3: Scipio Africanus, the Roman general who defeated Hannibal at Zama.
lines 1.5-1.8: Victory is to offer her hair to Italy (to be cut, as a slave's was), for God made her Rome's slave.
line 2.1: 'Stringiamci a coorte': close up as a cohort, the Roman legion's unit.
line 5.2: Legnano, where the Lombard League defeated Frederick Barbarossa (1176).
lines 5.3-5.4: literally 'every man of Ferruccio / has the heart, has the hand': every man has the heart and hand of Francesco Ferruccio, defender of the Florentine Republic (1530).
line 5.6: Balilla, the boy who started the Genoese revolt against the Austrians (1746): every Italian child is a Balilla.
line 5.8: the Sicilian Vespers, the rising against the Angevins (1282), begun at the bell for vespers.
lines 6.1-6.2: the mercenary swords (of Austria's hired troops) are rushes that bend.
lines 6.7-6.8: the Austrian Eagle drank Italian and Polish blood together with the Cossack (Russia), but that blood burned its heart.
